documentation.content:
The readiness check is failing. This alert exists because the API once stayed running while refusing to answer: transactions held every pooled connection, so every later request waited behind them. It was found by a load test, not by monitoring.

What to do:
1. Confirm with: curl https://windies-truck-tracker.web.app/api/health/ready
2. If poolStarved is true, look for a transaction that opens and then calls something needing a second connection. That was the original cause; the pattern is documented in docs/operations.md.
3. If it is not resolving, route traffic to the previous revision:
   gcloud run services update-traffic truck-tracker-api --project windies-app --region us-central1 --to-revisions <previous>=100

See docs/operations.md for the diagnosis query.

conditionMatchedLog.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="truck-tracker-api" AND jsonPayload.message="Readiness check failed"
